label: Simple antibiotic course (single medication)
text: Amoxicillin 500mg, take one capsule three times daily for five days.
demonstrates: Baseline parsing: name, strength, dose, frequency, duration, inferred oral route.

label: High-concern interaction (warfarin + NSAID)
text:
Warfarin 5 mg once daily at night.
Ibuprofen 400 mg tablet, take one tablet three times a day after food for 7 days.
demonstrates: High-concern bleeding interaction with source citation, plus a food instruction.

label: Abbreviated sig notation
text:
Tab Metformin 500mg PO BD x 30 days
Tab Atorvastatin 10mg PO HS
Tab Amlodipine 5mg OD
demonstrates: Latin/clinical abbreviations (PO, BD, HS, OD) and 'x 30 days' duration notation.

label: Incomplete prescription (missing fields)
demonstrates: Fields flagged for verification instead of being guessed, plus an absorption-timing interaction.

label: Duplicate therapy and brand names
text:
Brufen 400mg twice daily for 3 days
Naproxen 250mg, 1 tablet twice daily as needed for pain
demonstrates: Brand-name normalisation (Brufen to ibuprofen) and duplicate NSAID therapy detection.

label: Polypharmacy with allergy and condition risk
text:
1. Amoxicillin 500 mg capsule, one capsule three times a day for 7 days
2. Prednisolone 10mg tablet once daily in the morning for 5 days
3. Salbutamol inhaler, 2 puffs as needed, up to 4 times a day
4. Propranolol 40mg twice daily
demonstrates: Penicillin-allergy warning, asthma/beta-blocker caution, steroid-diabetes caution, inhaler route and PRN dosing.

label: Serotonin and sedation risk
text:
Sertraline 50mg once daily in the morning
Tramadol 50mg every 6 hours as needed for pain, maximum 4 doses per day
Alprazolam 0.25mg at bedtime
demonstrates: Serotonin-syndrome risk and the opioid/benzodiazepine boxed warning.

label: Hyperkalaemia and renal risk cluster
text:
Lisinopril 10 mg once daily
Spironolactone 25 mg once daily
Potassium chloride 600 mg twice daily
Ibuprofen 400mg three times daily when required
demonstrates: Multiple overlapping potassium-raising interactions plus NSAID renal caution.

label: Statin and macrolide (contraindicated pairing)
text:
Simvastatin 40mg at night
Clarithromycin 500mg twice daily for 7 days
demonstrates: High-concern myopathy risk requiring a prescriber decision.

label: No interaction found in the checked sources
text:
Cetirizine 10mg once daily at night for 10 days
Acetaminophen 500mg, 1 tablet every 6 hours as needed for fever
demonstrates: The 'no known interaction found' category and how its limitations are stated.
